verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software (Contract Generator, GDHQ, D&O Portal, SMART Request forms) and an internal AI chat app (ChatGD), so background automations are a fair question to ask. None of the evidence shows users can configure autonomous, scheduled or event-triggered automations. ChatGD is an attorney-only interactive query tool, and the self-service contract generator is on-demand, not a background automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
